text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a non-review research paper with a primary focus on land use land cover (LULC) prediction/simulation for the entire country of China. It explicitly implements spatially explicit national-scale land use change modeling using the Dyna-CLUE model. The study develops two future scenarios (2000s trend and planning scenario) and quantitatively compares them. Quantitative accuracy metrics such as quantity disagreement and allocation disagreement are reported for model validation. The outputs include mapped LULC projections for 2010 and 2020. The paper integrates LULC prediction with ecosystem service valuation but the central research question and primary objective remain the spatially explicit LULC prediction and scenario comparison at the national scale. It meets all core inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria.)
